desc:
Are you ready to escape Tim's farm?
Today is Farmer Tim's busy day, and he's got his hands full with chores around the farm. But Tim isn't exactly the most observant farmer, which gives us the perfect advantage to plan our escape!

Make your way through 22 challenging obstacles! If easy was not to challenging you can try hard!

Check out the shop for cool in game items or power-ups that can help you out throughout your escape!

ESCAPE TIM'S FARM OBBY! (FIRST PERSON OBBY!)
